source.title: ICRP Publication 89: Basic Anatomical and Physiological Data for Use in Radiological Protection: Reference Values
source.obtained_from: ICRP website, free to download under the Free the Annals Initiative (reuse needs ICRP permission; only individual values are recorded here, with citation).
source.storage: Kept on the platform owner's computer; not committed.
source.extraction: AI-assisted (Claude Fable, the owner's second account, 12 November 2026, in its Track H design draft), checked in this session: every quote is found in the PDF's text layer by scripts/check_source_quotes.py, with the PDF's SHA-256 matching file.sha256. Footnote letters printed beside a row name are kept as in the text layer ('Adipose tissuea'). Not yet reviewed by the platform owner.

applies_to: Reference adult woman and reference adult man (ICRP 89), each column read separately from the source; no sex multiplier. Not a patient value.

glomerular_filtration_rate.quote: In a middle-aged adult male, the glomerular ﬁlration rate (GFR) averages about 125 ml/min
glomerular_filtration_rate.also_quote: is lower on average in females than males
glomerular_filtration_rate.women_note: ICRP 89 gives no value for women; left empty, not estimated.

regional_flow_column_sums.formula: sum of the % of cardiac output columns, the liver counted by its arterial share (portal organs listed separately)

renal_plasma_flow_ml_min.formula: kidney blood flow x (1 - red cell fraction)

liver_portal_sum_pct.formula: arterial + stomach and oesophagus + small intestine + large intestine + pancreas + spleen

not_in_icrp_89: A glomerular filtration rate for women
Tissue densities (to turn masses into volumes), apart from blood
Tissue composition (water, neutral lipid, phospholipid) needed by partition-prediction methods

supersedes.change: Adds the reference woman and more quantities; the three men's values of v1 (6.5 L/min, 19%, 43%) are unchanged. v1 stays pinned and is still what the pages use.

not_this: Reference physiology for a reference woman or man: not this patient's values, not adjusted for kidney function, age or body size.
